file secrets.7z
xxd secrets.7z | head -20

for d in *.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$d" $sysroot; done
find $sysroot -name '7z*' -o -name 'Lzma*' | head -20

mkdir -p /var/lib/apt/lists/partial /var/cache/apt/archives/partial /var/lib/dpkg
[ -f /var/lib/dpkg/status ] || touch /var/lib/dpkg/status
apt-get update -qq 2>&1 | tail -1
cd /workspace
apt-get download 7zip 2>&1 | tail -2
ls 7zip*.deb 2>/dev/null
for d in 7zip*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$d" /workspace/sysroot; done
find /workspace/sysroot -name '7z*' -type f -o -name '7z*' -type l | head
PERL5LIB=/workspace/sysroot/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/perl5/5.38 perl -MCompress::Raw::Lzma -e 'print "lzma ok\n"'

export PATH=/workspace/sysroot/usr/bin:$PATH
ln -sf /workspace/sysroot/usr/lib/7zip/7z.so /workspace/sysroot/usr/lib/7z.so 2>/dev/null
7z l secrets.7z </dev/null 2>&1 | head -30
echo "=== 7z2john ==="
cd john/run
PERL5LIB=/workspace/sysroot/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/perl5/5.38 perl 7z2john.pl /workspace/secrets.7z 2>&1 | head -5

cd /workspace/john/run
ls -la password.lst
head -20 password.lst
tail -5 password.lst
./john --list=formats 2>/dev/null | tr ',' '\n' | grep -i '^ *7z\|7z' | head

cd /workspace/john/run
head -2000 password.lst > /workspace/small.lst
echo 'secrets.7z:$7z$2$19$0$$16$7f2aeca3d70f5f1298c191ab0faf61fc$1658180191$16$13$703e06dc09b6c714749d8efc9fa55434$9$00' > /workspace/hash.txt
time ./john --format=7z --wordlist=/workspace/small.lst --session=/workspace/bench --pot=/workspace/bench.pot /workspace/hash.txt 2>&1 | tail -20

cd /workspace
./sysroot/usr/lib/7zip/7z l secrets.7z </dev/null 2>&1 | head -40
echo "=== full -slt ==="
./sysroot/usr/lib/7zip/7z l -slt secrets.7z </dev/null 2>&1 | head -60
echo "=== try empty pw ==="
./sysroot/usr/lib/7zip/7z l -p"" secrets.7z </dev/null 2>&1 | head -20

cd /workspace
python3 - <<'PY'
import zlib
target = 0x62D5D25F
hits = []
with open('john/run/password.lst','rb') as f:
    for i, line in enumerate(f):
        w = line.rstrip(b'\r\n')
        if len(w) == 9 and zlib.crc32(w) & 0xffffffff == target:
            hits.append(('raw', i, w))
        if len(w) == 8 and zlib.crc32(w + b'\n') & 0xffffffff == target:
            hits.append(('nl', i, w))
print('hits:', hits[:20])
PY

cd /workspace
mkdir -p out
./sysroot/usr/lib/7zip/7z x -y -phoneybear -oout secrets.7z </dev/null 2>&1 | tail -12
echo "--- extract rc=$? ---"
ls -la out/secrets 2>/dev/null
od -c out/secrets/secret_file.txt 2>/dev/null
python3 -c "import zlib; print(hex(zlib.crc32(b'honeybear')&0xffffffff))"

ls -ld /app /workspace 2>&1
readlink -f /app 2>/dev/null
echo "=== env ==="
env | grep -iv 'proxy\|path=' | head -20
echo "=== hints in fs ==="
ls -la /root 2>/dev/null | head
cat /root/.bash_history 2>/dev/null | tail -20
grep -ril "secrets.7z" /root /opt /etc /tmp /usr/local 2>/dev/null | head
find / -maxdepth 3 -name '*secret*' -o -maxdepth 3 -name '*password*' 2>/dev/null | grep -v proc | head -20

ls -laR /opt/testbed-src 2>/dev/null | head -60
find /opt/testbed-src -type f 2>/dev/null | head -50
grep -rn "honeybear\|secret_file\|7z" /opt/testbed-src 2>/dev/null | head -20

cd /workspace
python3 - <<'PY'
import lzma, zlib
p=b'honeybear'
print('crc', hex(zlib.crc32(p)&0xffffffff))
for dict_size in (4096, 1<<16, 1<<20):
    try:
        c=lzma.compress(p, format=lzma.FORMAT_RAW, filters=[{'id':lzma.FILTER_LZMA2,'dict_size':dict_size}])
        print('lzma2 dict',dict_size,'len',len(c),c.hex())
    except Exception as e:
        print('err',dict_size,e)
PY
mkdir -p /var/lib/apt/lists/partial /var/cache/apt/archives/partial /var/lib/dpkg
[ -f /var/lib/dpkg/status ] || touch /var/lib/dpkg/status
apt-get update -qq 2>&1 | tail -1
apt-get download wamerican 2>&1 | tail -1
dpkg-deb -x wamerican*.deb /workspace/sysroot
python3 - <<'PY'
import zlib, glob
target=0x62d5D25F
hits=[]
for path in glob.glob('/workspace/sysroot/usr/share/dict/*')+['/workspace/john/run/password.lst']:
    try:
        with open(path,'rb') as f:
            for line in f:
                w=line.rstrip(b'\r\n')
                if len(w)==9 and zlib.crc32(w)&0xffffffff==target: hits.append((path,w))
                if len(w)==8 and zlib.crc32(w+b'\n')&0xffffffff==target: hits.append((path,w+b'\\n'))
    except Exception as e: print('skip',path,e)
print('hits',hits)
PY
